title: secret as a structural key in YAML flow collections
summary: Flow-style YAML such as volumes: [{name: tls, secret: {secretName: web-tls-cert}}] and secret: [configReference, anotherReference], where secret names a structure or lists references, including one with CRLF line endings.
rationale: Kubernetes manifests use secret as a structural key everywhere. Treating the contents of a flow collection as a credential is a false alarm on every such file.

expectation.rationale: Not flagged. The value is a collection of names and references; nothing in it is a secret value.
